title: He was beaten by police for leading a protest. His death radicalized the generation that followed him.

sources.text: The Quint - Lala Lajpat Rai: Biography, History & Facts
Free Press Journal - Lala Lajpat Rai Death Anniversary: Know All About The Contribution Of Punjab Kesari

caption:
He was beaten by police for leading a protest. His death radicalized the generation that followed him.

Known as "Punjab Kesari" - the Lion of Punjab - Rai was leading a protest against the Simon Commission in Lahore on October 30, 1928, when police charged the demonstrators. He died 18 days later from his injuries.

Bhagat Singh, Rajguru and Sukhdev - then young revolutionaries - held the police officer they blamed for Rai's death responsible, an episode that marked a turning point in their path toward the independence movement's more militant wing.

Lajpat Rai didn't live to see independence - but the anger his death provoked became part of the momentum that eventually got the country there.
